meta.parties: Doloswela Rubber & Tea Estate Co v. Swaris Appu Et Al

rules.statement: A respondent cannot use section 772 of the Civil Procedure Code to object to a decree in favor of other respondents.
rules.supporting_quote: "These objections are really directed to reducing the 1/2, share given to the second intervenient respondent. Grounds (1) and (2) are clearly so intended, and if the plaintiff succeeds on these it would affect the decree so far as the appellant is concerned, not adversely but by enlarging his share to 1/4; these grounds cannot, therefore, be regarded as those on which the plaintiff objects to the decree in favour of the appellant"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 772 of the Civil Procedure Code
